title: The report hook that checks reviewer model names stops flagging an earlier round's correct model
why: Lane ux-order-rule-scope, relayed by the coordinator 2026-11-07 02:19 CST: the report Stop hook that checks reviewer model names flagged a correct reviewer model 4 times in one session. It seems to read only the latest reviewer spawn, so an earlier round's correct model reads as wrong. A guard that cries wolf is spent (verification-cry-wolf-guard-is-spent).
note:
Folded in, 13:40 CST Nov 7 (coordinator): Owner ask, 13:20 CST Nov 7 ("why not fix it then"): the report guard that wants each Done item to name its agents' models flags Next lines as Done items. Lane session_013NEJL1SsG5NZULw1mG6qgB. Done: a red test where a Next line under a report is flagged, then green; Done lines are still checked.
Own lane, red test first: a transcript with two reviewer spawns on different models, where the report names each one correctly, goes red on main's hook and green after the fix.
